description: The signed-in couple's own wedding checklist on Zola: mark 1 task as done, or as not done again. Get the task_id from zola_get_my_checklist first. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same task_id, completed and confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Status: preview (nothing changed yet), nothing_to_change (the task already has this state), done (changed), draft_changed (the task changed on zola.com: show the new preview and ask again). A call with a used confirm_token returns the stored result. The couple can change the task again later. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

completed.description: true marks the task as done. false marks it as not done

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same task_id and completed

name: zola_complete_my_checklist_task

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a change of a checklist task of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the checklist

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_complete_my_checklist_task with the same task_id and completed, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The checklist tasks with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_get_my_checklist gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

removal_count.description: 1 when the task goes back to not done: its completion date is removed

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Complete My Checklist Task
